verdict: Yes. Alpino from Surat pitched roasted peanut butter on Shark Tank India Season 1, but didn't get a deal. Peanut butter has become a staple for fitness buyers, and Gujarat is a major peanut-growing region.
angle: Peanut butter is a cheap protein source for gym-goers. Gujarat grows most of India's peanuts. Flavours, natural recipes and protein claims set brands apart.
